model_revision_control.mechanism: Canonical review/apply checks base_model_revision and every expected_version inside a project RequestUnit.

repair.root_cause: Capacity splitting drops old drawing ports but materialization does not reconcile the primary Message.hardware_interface_id with the approved physical senders. It creates replacement channels even when the same reviewed connector moves entirely to one network. Manual assignment and zoning already reconcile the primary.
repair.first_failing_layer: Persisted primary sender left behind after approved capacity split
repair.reproduction: Delivered canonical planner finds stale primary references against already approved current physical paths.
acceptance_criteria: Every selected primary matches approved topology bindings
No changes to signals, encodings, recipients, physical topology or hardware inventory
targeted_tests: 55 isolated regressions and complete deployed release gate
